notes.title: Combat is 98% Done.
notes.content:
We've spent the past month creating and implementing animations for the Henchmen.


One play tester noted that our Henchmen felt too static, so we've focused on creating dynamic movements that show case the mechanical nature of their bodies and make them more reactive to gun fire.



Headshot Stagger Animation:

Triggered when you shoot the Henchmen’s chin or visor. This long stagger buys you time to reload or escape.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/aba6591d760c82d0828108056baef41b3e34c6f4.gif"]

Punch Attack Animation:

Triggered when a Henchman reaches you. Currently undodgeable, but that may change based on feedback. If you get hit, you’re stunned for half a second—your best bet is to run and retaliate.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/422869433f5f1d11b67c5563b1538ac7adfaf9bd.gif"]


We also released a new Combat Reel on our YouTube channel showcasing recent progress.

[previewyoutube="_fB1hWBseHI;full"][/previewyoutube]

Here's what you'll see in the video:
1. Henchmen punch attacks 

2. Henchmen: 3 stagger animations (face, left, right) 

3. Aim assist + aim glide improvements 

4. Grapple vs. Corpse Spawn 

5. Guided missile vs. THUG aircraft 

6. Elite henchmen punch-out execution 

7. Directional reaction hits (player) 

8. Ranged henchmen evasion 

9. 2 Corpse Spawn variations 

10. Improved Corpse Shifter shield VFX


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293640/Alter_Evo/"][/dynamiclink]What's left before we launch the game? [olist]
 Finalize ammo box art and pick up placement in each map

 Place new enemy types in each level of the game

 Add more combat sections to secondary areas.

 Playtest, playtest, playtest.

 Sound polish.

 Cut scene improvements.
[/olist]
Thanks for checking out our post! Wishlist Alter Evo and play the demo today!


-Technical Fiction

notes.title: Upgrade System in the Works — We Want Your Feedback!
notes.content:
What's new?
We’re working on a new combat upgrade system to make exploration, fighting, and progression more rewarding. As you move through levels and defeat enemies, you’ll collect Nanite Canisters, which can be used to upgrade your weapon's:


 Fire Rate
 Damage
 Reload Speed
 Clip Size

This is our current iteration of the Alter Evo Upgrade Bench:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/b337f3937ef2d38f943933e465260c1ca57e2ae1.png
We need your input!
Right now, the system is still in development and not yet in the demo. But we want your input—
Would you want to see more weapons?
What kinds of upgrades would feel most satisfying?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/8e94085c554c032f4367a36d226860edb8ba7b57.gif

Play the Alter Evo demo today, and let us know your thoughts!
– Technical Fiction

notes.title: Big Demo Update Coming February 13th
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you to everyone who has checked out the Alter Evo demo so far! We've noticed that many players are dropping off within the first 10 minutes, so we're making some changes to improve retention.

We are officially adding Gun Combat to improve the fun and play-ability of enemy sections.

We are making game flow and narrative improvements across the board.

All of these changes will be released on February 13th.

We will leave the demo up in it's current form until then.

Thanks again for your support.

Technical Fiction
